research_questions: RQ1: among commits that touch Python source, what fraction also touch tests?
RQ2: is that fraction different for bug-fix commits than for other commits?
RQ3: does the fraction differ between earlier and later history (per-repo median date split)?
project_selection: public Python projects with >=300 commits and a tests tree; chosen for ecosystem diversity (CLI library, HTTP client, modern async client); vendored forks excluded
time_split: per-repo median commit date; commits in the earlier half vs later half of each repo's history
dedup_policy: merge commits excluded; one commit is one unit; no same-message dedup

label_source.unit: commit touching at least one .py file
label_source.outcome: same commit also touches tests/ or test_*.py or *_test.py

boundary: exploratory repository-mining study on three public Python projects; labels are path/message heuristics; no Claim/EA/signature
